description.value:
You learn a number of special rituals that you can complete as part of a Short or Long Rest. You may only choose one of these rituals at a time and the effects last until you complete your next Short or Long Rest.

Bounty of the Earth. When you forage for food or ingredients, you can treat a d20 roll of 8 or lower as a 9. If your Foraging check is successful, you roll an additional d4 and add it to the result of the die on the result column.

Eye of Newt, Wing of Bat. Select a number of non-masterwork consumables equal to your spellcasting ability modifier that your group crafted on this Adventuring Day using alchemist's supplies, cook's utensils, herbalist's kit, or poisoner's kit. The selected items receive the masterwork property.

Nature's Veil. When your group makes a Prepare Campsite check, you can treat a d20 roll of 8 or lower as a 9. Additionally, you and up to 8 other creatures of your choice regain additional hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier + half your Witch Level when you complete your next Short Rest on this Adventuring Day.

Snake Stomach. If your group consumes a meal as part of this rest, the duration of the effect is increased by 1 day. The same meal can only be affected by this ritual once.

Whispers of the Wild. When your group makes a Lookout check, you can treat a d20 roll of 8 or lower as a 9. Additionally, you add your spellcasting ability modifier to your passive Perception and that of up to 8 other creatures of your choice.

Witch Path. 3 doesn't slow your group's travel and whenever your group makes a Pathfinding check, you can treat a d20 roll of 8 or lower as a 9.
